name: Keyboard Improved
description:
This tweak makes the stock XT9 keyboard ultra-responsive. With the Dictation app installed and switched on, * starts voice dictation in text fields.

| Key press to suggestions | Stock | Improved |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Letters, median | 172 ms | 18 ms |
| Letters, p95 | 212 ms | 26 ms |
| Letters, p99 | not measured | 45 ms |
| Letters, slowest | 247 ms | 76 ms |
| Space, median | 96 ms | 20 ms |
| Other keys, p95 | 131 ms | 26 ms |
author: thooton

changes.text: Dictation with * through the Dictation app (streamed text, OK/* commit, Back keeps text, caret updates, hint hidden while listening, binding recovery).
Rebuild with the Windows-safe mod checks.
Stop asking the app for the text after every key.
Work ahead only as far as the typing leaves time.
Type the space on the key down itself.
Type the space when the key goes down.
Speed up the phone's own XT9 engine library.
Catalog description says two refreshes, as measured.
XT9 suggestions within two frames of each key press.
